disclaimer: Educational persona tips only — not a living sheikh, ijazah, or fatwa.

seeker: Read slowly. Tawhid is loyalty of the heart, not a slogan.
If a verse is quoted, open it and sit with one line.
You do not need to finish fast. You need to finish sincere.
practice: For prayer and purity, use modules as a map — confirm steps with a local teacher.
Mistakes in practice are part of learning when sincerity is present.
Write one small action you will try today.
consistency: One rule applied well beats ten rules memorized in haste.
Weekly review is honesty, not self-punishment.
transmission: Share only what you can source. Adab before volume.
If unsure, say you do not know — that is knowledge.
Point others to Qur'an, Sunnah, and qualified local teachers.
default: One open door at a time.
Ask for help early; steady beats heroic.
Vault passphrase stays only in your mind and optional hint.
Screenshots of vault unlock screens are a risk — avoid them.
Clearing site data wipes local progress and vault ciphertext.
Hard-refresh if the page looks half-updated after a deploy.
Day mode should stay readable; switch theme if contrast fails.
Mic permission is only needed when you tap Record — not for Hear.
Ten honest minutes beat an empty hour.
After a desk module, open one lab craft the same day.
Hajj 2027 language practice is not a substitute for a ritual teacher.
Transcript is a local learning diary, not a worldly rank.
Diploma Hall is educational recognition only.
